title: FumosCraft
description: [WIP] This modification adds Fumos to the game.
body:
This is my first modification, so please tell me about what should I add next time.

This modification adds Fumos. As for now, only existent plushies are Koishi Fumo and Template Fumo. All fumos are currently not obtainable in survival mode.

Models made with Blockbench\
Fumos probably made by Gift\
Touhou by Team Shanghai Alice
